title: Sleep Plus Collagen Cream
body_html:
Your skin does its best repair work at night — and our Sleep Plus Collagen Cream is built around that biology. This rich but non-greasy night collagen cream combines plant-derived collagen-supporting ingredients with Hyaluronic Acid, Melatonin, and Avocado Oil to deliver deep overnight hydration, visibly firmer texture, and a plumper, more rested complexion by morning. Vegan. Clean. Fragrance-free of synthetic scent, with a subtle natural lavender calm.

Key Ingredients

  • Collagen (plant-sourced, topical): The collagen in this formula is vegan and plant-derived. It functions as a film-forming, hydrating agent on the skin's surface — it does not replace collagen in your dermis (no topical protein can; the molecule is too large to penetrate). What it does is create a supportive, cushioning layer that locks in moisture and signals the environment your skin needs to produce more of its own collagen over time. More on this in the FAQ below.
  • Hyaluronic Acid: A powerhouse humectant that draws water to the skin's surface and holds it there through the night — fighting the transepidermal water loss (TEWL) that accelerates as we sleep, especially in air-conditioned or heated rooms.
  • Melatonin: Best known as a sleep hormone, topical melatonin is also a potent antioxidant that helps neutralize free radicals during the skin's overnight repair window. Each quarter-teaspoon contains 2.4mg of topical melatonin.
  • Avocado Oil: Rich in oleic acid, vitamins E, D, and A, and essential fatty acids, avocado oil replenishes the lipid layer that dry and mature skin loses over time — working with your skin's natural overnight repair cycle.
  • Aloe Vera Extract & Rosemary Leaf Extract: Aloe calms and hydrates while Rosemary provides antioxidant protection, rounding out a formula that soothes and defends through the night.

What It Does

  • Deep overnight hydration — Hyaluronic Acid and Avocado Oil work together to prevent moisture loss and replenish the lipid barrier while you sleep.
  • Collagen-supporting environment — The surface collagen layer and peptide-supporting actives create conditions that encourage your skin's own collagen synthesis over time.
  • Antioxidant overnight repair — Topical Melatonin and Rosemary Leaf Extract neutralize free radical damage accumulated during the day, letting skin focus on repair rather than damage-control.
  • Plumper, firmer texture — Wake up to visibly more supple skin, reduced fine lines from hydration, and a cushiony, rested-looking complexion.
  • Calming pre-sleep ritual — A gentle natural lavender note (from Lavender Oil) promotes relaxation as part of a wind-down skincare routine.

How to Use

  1. Apply 1/4 teaspoon to clean face and neck 45 minutes to 1 hour before bedtime.
  2. Increase to 1/2 teaspoon if needed for drier or more mature skin.
  3. Massage gently in upward strokes until absorbed.
  4. Apply after serum and eye cream as the final step in your PM routine.
  5. Note: Each 1/4 tsp contains 2.4mg of topical melatonin.

Routine Pairing

Sleep Plus Collagen Cream is the ideal PM closer after our Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum. The recommended evening stack: cleanser → Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum (active serum layer) → Peptide Eye Gel-Cream (under-eye) → Sleep Plus Collagen Cream (seal everything in as final moisturizer). The PDRN serum drives targeted brightening and peptide action; this cream provides the rich overnight hydration layer that makes those actives more effective. In the morning, PDRN serum is your go-to, with SPF as the final step.

Who It's For

Made for health-conscious moms with dry, maturing, or stress-reactive skin who want a rich nighttime moisturizer that's honest about what it contains and what it does. If you've been burned by vague "collagen cream" claims before, read our FAQ — we explain exactly how this works. Ideal for anyone who wakes up with tight, dull skin and wants to add a targeted overnight repair step to a clean, vegan skincare routine.

Free From

No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates • No animal derivatives • Vegan • No artificial dyes

Full Ingredient List

Collagen, Hyaluronic Acid, Melatonin, Avocado Oil, Lavender Oil, Aloe Vera Extract, Rosemary Leaf Extract

Suggested Use: Apply 1/4 teaspoon to face and neck 45 minutes to 1 hour before bedtime. Increase to 1/2 teaspoon if needed. Each 1/4 tsp contains 2.4mg of topical melatonin.

Warning: For external use only. Avoid eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin. Store in a cool, dry place.

faq_json.question: Is this actually vegan collagen? What's in it?
faq_json.answer: We want to be direct about this, because "vegan collagen cream" is a claim that gets thrown around loosely in the beauty industry. Here's what's honest: this cream contains plant-derived topical collagen — a film-forming, hydrating ingredient that sits on the surface of your skin. It is NOT the same as injecting collagen or rebuilding dermal collagen from the inside. No topical collagen can do that; the collagen molecule is far too large to penetrate the dermis regardless of whether it's bovine or plant-derived. What this formula does is create a supportive, moisture-locking layer at the skin surface — while the Hyaluronic Acid, Avocado Oil, and antioxidants create the environment your skin needs to produce more of its own collagen over time. That is the honest version of 'collagen-supporting skincare.' We think crunchy moms deserve the real explanation.

faq_json.question: How do I layer this in my PM routine?
faq_json.answer: Sleep Plus Collagen Cream goes on last — it's your final PM step. The order: cleanser, then our Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum (active serum layer, thinnest consistency first), then Peptide Eye Gel-Cream on the under-eye area, then Sleep Plus Collagen Cream over your full face and neck to seal everything in. Apply 45 minutes to an hour before bed so it has time to absorb before your pillow does.

faq_json.question: Can I use this during pregnancy or while breastfeeding?
faq_json.answer: Always check with your OB or midwife before adding new products during pregnancy or breastfeeding. This formula does not contain retinoids, retinol, salicylic acid, or hydroquinone. It does contain Lavender Oil (natural fragrance) and topical Melatonin — both worth flagging to your provider. Melatonin in particular has limited data on topical use during pregnancy, so we'd recommend your provider reviews the full ingredient list with you before use.

faq_json.question: Does this pair with the PDRN serum?
faq_json.answer: Yes — they're designed to work together in a PM routine. Think of it as: PDRN serum provides the targeted active work (brightening, peptide signaling, barrier support), and Sleep Plus Collagen Cream provides the rich hydration layer that helps those actives work more effectively overnight. In the morning, PDRN serum is still your go-to; this cream is a PM product. The two together give you a complete AM/PM clean skincare stack.

faq_json.question: How much should I use?
faq_json.answer: Start with 1/4 teaspoon (about a pea-sized dollop) for your full face and neck. If you have dry or mature skin, or if you find your skin still feels tight in the morning, you can increase to 1/2 teaspoon. One jar at 1/4 tsp nightly should last approximately 2–3 months. Note: each 1/4 tsp dose contains 2.4mg of topical melatonin.

faq_json.question: How long until I see firming results?
faq_json.answer: Immediate hydration improvements — plumper, more cushiony skin in the morning — are often noticeable within the first week. For visible firming, reduction in fine lines, and improved skin density, consistent nightly use over 4–8 weeks is when most people see meaningful change. Collagen-supporting results require sustained daily habits; skin remodeling is a slow process even with the best actives.

faq_json.question: Is it heavy enough for dry or mature skin?
faq_json.answer: Yes — this is one of the richer products in our line. The combination of Avocado Oil (which is high in oleic acid and deeply nourishing for dry, mature skin), topical Collagen, and Hyaluronic Acid creates a formula that addresses both surface dryness and deeper barrier repair. If you have oily or combination skin, you may prefer it only in winter or as a targeted treatment on dry patches rather than as an all-over nightly moisturizer. For dry and mature skin, this is designed to be your primary evening moisturizer.
